_comment: The other nine redirects live in astro.config.mjs, where Astro compiles them into the build output AND serves them in `astro dev`, so they are covered by real end-to-end tests. This one cannot go there: Astro rejects it at build time with InvalidRedirectDestination because the destination of a dynamic redirect must include all the source's dynamic parameters, and a query string is not a route. 308 matches what production answers today.

headers.value: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline' https://challenges.cloudflare.com https://va.vercel-scripts.com; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data: blob: https:; font-src 'self' data:; connect-src 'self' https://challenges.cloudflare.com https://va.vercel-scripts.com https://vitals.vercel-insights.com; frame-src 'self' https://challenges.cloudflare.com; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'self'; form-action 'self'; frame-ancestors 'none'; manifest-src 'self'; upgrade-insecure-requests
